title: Company goal transcription and responsibility bridge
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a repeatable process and artifact set to translate company-level objectives into explicit, measurable team commitments and decision handoffs. Deliver a lightweight "Responsibility Bridge" ledger (template + tooling recommendations) that product, engineering, and cross-functional leads can sign off on at planning cadence. Goal: reduce ambiguity in what teams own for each company objective, speed up planning negotiations, and create a single source of truth for escalations and trade-offs.
background: Past quarters we saw delays and scope slippage during cross-team planning because company objectives were not consistently decomposed into team-level KRs or decision ownership. Multiple teams interpreted priority differently, causing duplicated work, missed gates, and last-minute re-scopes. This ticket aims to formalize a 'transcription' step during company planning where PMs translate goals into team asks and capture the trade-offs and acceptance criteria in a signed ledger.
proposal: 1) Define a standard 'transcription' template (objective -> measurable translation -> minimum viable deliverable -> owner -> decision window -> fallback policy). 2) Pilot the template across 3 company objectives with Eng, Design, and Reliability leads. 3) Build a 'Responsibility Bridge' Google Sheet + Confluence page and add a Linear workflow integration (tags + auto-generated sub-issues). 4) Introduce a 30-minute cross-functional sign-off ritual during planning cycle where owners agree on scope, KPIs, and escalation path.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible template exists in Confluence and Google Sheets and is accessible to all PMs
Three company objectives have completed transcription artifacts with signed owners and documented decision windows
Linear automation creates sub-issues for each team commitment and links back to the master ledger
At least two cross-functional disputes were prevented or resolved faster in the pilot window (measured via post-mortem notes)
Operations handbook updated to include the sign-off ritual and the responsibility bridge reference

risks_mitigation: Risk: Template becomes bureaucratic and teams stop using it. Mitigation: Keep template intentionally one page; measure adoption and deprecate fields that are unused after pilot.
Risk: Owners sign off but don't deliver. Mitigation: Linear sub-issues will have acceptance criteria and weekly sync; escalation path documented on ledger.
Risk: Tooling integration delays. Mitigation: Start with manual Google Sheet + Confluence; iterate automation in a follow-up ticket.
Risk: Overlap with other governance docs. Mitigation: Link to existing OKR handbook and ensure single canonical artifact (Confluence page)
